newsitem.title: KUWAIT: KPC supplies S.Africa with 22 pct of crude imports.
newsitem.headline: KPC supplies S.Africa with 22 pct of crude imports.

text.p: Kuwait Petroleum Corp (KPC) said on Tuesday it supplies South Africa with 22 percent of its total crude oil imports, the official Kuwait News Agency reported.
"Kuwaiti crude accounts for 22 percent of the total crude oil imports of South Africa," the agency quoted a KPC official as saying.
Kuwaiti crude exports to South Africa rose to 30 million barrels a year in 1996 from nine million barrels in the previous year, he said.

The KPC official was commenting on the 1996 annual report of the South African Petroleum Industry Association which said crude purchases by the Association's six members from Kuwait rose to 20.9 million barrels in 1996 from 4.2 million in 1995.
The agency said the figures in the Association's report were "incorrect."
State-owned conglomerate KPC runs the Gulf country's oil industry, whose crude oil production amounts to about two million barrels per day.
